text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A in pieces after large gains locked in profits, but I should base future decisions on its prospects and my overall portfolio—not just how much it is up from my cost.","A few months of account gains and losses do not establish a reliable trading strategy; I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make me reluctant to sell a losing position. I should assess every holding consistently and consider its role in the diversified portfolio."]}
